_why: THE BULWARK's boss room for a campaign level (NIGHT25 W, design.n25.bosses.bulwark): a closed flat room, 44 m across inside, 20 m high: the boss's arenaHalf (design bulwark.arenaHalf 18) plus 4 m so its ram probe and its walls are real. Built only from axis-aligned boxes for the C# collider, like wyrm-arena.json. ARENA-LOCAL coordinates (centre 0, 0, 0, floor y 0); the sim offsets it to design.n25.bosses.bulwark.room.origin. The player enters at the south wall (z +19) facing north; the boss walks in through the north (its own start at centre z - arenaHalf + radius). Generated by Design/maps/gen script from these numbers.
name: bulwark-arena
